note: Seedance 2.5 · 720p · 9:16 · 5 s · no audio. Start images are the brand deck's own photos (axi-select-videos/assets/img) recomposed for 9:16. Prompts: one main action, camera move with magnitude, light, no text.

shots.prompt: The man in the black polo looks down at his red phone, then lifts his eyes to the camera with a confident half-smile. Camera pushes in fast from waist to chest-up, slight handheld energy. Dark studio, deep red rim light from behind, soft blurred red and white candlestick-chart lights drifting in the background. Cinematic, high contrast, 35mm, shallow depth of field. No text.

The woman in the red polo looks up from her red laptop and smiles; the screen light flickers red on her face. Camera orbits slowly from her left side to the front, 30 degrees. Dark studio, crimson rim light, faint haze. Cinematic, shallow depth of field. No text.

The two traders at the table lean toward their red laptops; the man points at his screen and the woman nods, both focused then smiling. Camera dollies in from wide to medium, smooth. Dark studio with a red glow behind them. Cinematic, realistic motion. No text.

The gold XAU bar and the silver XAG bar rotate slowly in the dark while a thin red light beam sweeps across their engraved metal surfaces, sharp reflections glinting. Camera arcs around them 40 degrees and pushes in. Macro product shot, black background. No new text.

The polished silver coin spins on its edge, then flips and falls flat in slow motion, light streaking across its rim. Camera tracks the motion close. Pure black background, red reflections. Macro, cinematic.

Drone shot gliding fast low over black sand dunes at night toward a lone figure standing on the ridge; wind blows fine sand off the crest. Camera rushes forward and rises slightly. Moody blue-black moonlight, cinematic, epic scale.

Travellers with suitcases walk past a giant illuminated airport billboard; the man on the billboard looks at his red phone. Camera dollies slowly forward and tilts up toward the billboard, reflections gliding on the polished floor. Night terminal, cinematic.
FPV drone flies very fast through a dark volcanic rock canyon toward a narrow opening of light, banking left then right, heavy motion blur. Cinematic, high energy.

Extreme macro of a dark trading monitor: glowing red and white candlestick bars rise one after another; the camera races forward low between the candles like a flythrough, anamorphic flares, shallow depth of field, deep black background. No letters or numbers.

Close-up of a hand holding a red smartphone in a dark room; the thumb taps the screen and a bright red line chart shoots upward on the display, its glow lighting the fingers. Camera pushes in slowly, shallow depth of field. No readable text.

Night aerial hyperlapse over a modern Middle Eastern city on a wide river, illuminated bridges and towers, streams of red and white traffic light trails. Camera flies forward fast and banks. Cinematic, deep blue and red tones.

Abstract: six glowing red light steps rise one after another out of darkness forming a staircase, volumetric haze, the camera climbs upward with them step by step, sleek and minimal, black background. No text.

A trader seen from behind sits at a desk with three monitors full of red and white candlestick charts in a dark glass office overlooking city lights at night. Camera pushes in slowly over his shoulder. Cinematic, moody, red accents. No readable text.
Extreme close-up of the same man's eyes; tiny red candlestick charts reflect in his pupils, he blinks once and narrows his focus. Camera holds, very slight push. Dark, red rim light, cinematic macro.

Hands typing fast on a black keyboard with red backlight, quick rack focus from the keys to a monitor glowing with candlestick charts. Camera slides sideways. Dark, cinematic, shallow depth of field. No readable text.

The same man in the black polo walks confidently toward the camera down a dark corridor lined with vertical red light strips, slow motion. Camera tracks backward low-angle in front of him. Cinematic, high contrast.
